### 2026-10-05: ![image_2026-10-05_222519479](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/e20ec0cdb7338dd9a1f3f31873e532c007e2c424502a9462589a3a2e43be1ec8.png)

After about an hour of working, Finally figured out KiCad(mostly, I still suck a bit)

So today was the first day using KiCad,I had to make Starbie on it. Initially I

![Screenshot 2026-10-05 212333](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/1cda410be9746ecdaae1b66aebcc1df4574edaf5078421eb0446df8f3a7d7fc6.png)

struggled quite a lot, but after the first hour of messing around on it, I finally figured it out.

It took a lot of time to figure how to do anything on KiCad ,but after figuring out(mainly through trial and error, and lots of random clicking) how, it was immensely satisfying to do things. It felt like playing with the circuit equivalent of Legos. It was great!

tl;dr is I spent the first day  figuring out how to wok on KiCad and find joy in working on it. It's just a matter of messing around a bit till everything starts making sense

### 2026-10-11: Finishing Today:

**4.2h**

Finishing Today:
so today I decided to fix that one border issue I keep getting since I  started using the PCB editor. I thought the pixel star was the issue so i made it using polygons, then trace over it with lines to make it more precise but I got errors in more absurd locations instead (like how the air is the problem now)

![1000128770](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/c01cb7f8d1f8441e115bc7e3e90da62cc25cac7c87c21dd51148e6bdbfe16f0f.jpg)

Or how the perfectly straight lines have gaps in them, probably in between the atoms or so

![1000128769](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/49d07ea92902daa381a58e8a98dde0af2532e132658f74e871b611c13745179e.jpg)

and so I remade the whole star again TWICE then finally closed the program and opened it again (I had done so prior but it didn't solve anything).BUT FINALLY

![image_2026-10-11_201303291](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/80d719b5aadf6b77f2f837c951a1511327426d12f13491fb88fd09d32e80c226.png)

IT WAS  RESOLVED!!! That brought me immense joy
After that moved on to the coding. It was rather tame in comparision.Mostly because it was just copy pasting. But I was unsatisfied with having the star effect, so after a lot of googling, checking how to do it in yt and verifying the code with Claude.I got

![image_2026-10-11_201608322](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/076a41b0fec965efd4315aae9f49eb39c33864e9091c46057f0a8261c87edabe.png)

This fire effect, which i hope works. I  don't have much of a way to test it. Claude said its fine tho.

After that moved on to making the Pet,which I made as a 64x48 dude on Pixel Studio

![1000128888](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/4b78ce367cf0b1ca116b06709bf89934cc50d1ebe3f731cc27d6a841ef628a33.jpg)

Of course he was reduces to black and white, but he still looks fine. After that finished up Coding and verified if everything is in order.Uploaded all the necessary files to Github and then went on a thrift basically to find the cheapest parts possible. The main issue was the delivery fees for most sites, which were sometimes over the budget of the project itself,ofc that wouldn't matter if I bought stuff in bulk, but I have no use for 200 220 ohm resistors.Also the display looks cool,for a great price too

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 181604](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/1beac2148577d51e823c8890b03e6787bd7a29a2da8294470dcfc8cdef1ff4f2.png)

After that realised I had saved some stuff wrong on KiCad and tweaked that,the Github upload was fine,just my saves were a bit off.After that uploaded everything to submit and then Verified my details in Hackclub now,tho I gotta wait a business day for them to do it, idk what to do now. It'll be fine probably.

Tldr:now my PCB is finally error free,coded in Arduino,Added custom fire effect,Made a sprite on my own named Gumpo,Uploaded everything to Github,Went shop hunting for half an hour,and now hoping hackclub verifies my info quickly.

BUT WEEK 1 HAS ENDED! WOOOOOOOOOO
(It was very fun)

### 2026-10-26: So Similar to week 3 Project, ran into issues with PCB size here.That being it was too large to fabricate it.

**1.5h**

So Similar to week 3 Project, ran into issues with PCB size here.That being it was too large to fabricate it.

So I decided to split them again, only realizing after splitting the first one that this is very inefficient.

![image_2026-10-27_003922862](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/e548a8ed59b3e4cf197fd0d3e021f6aa4775f88e8110280936dcc6eddf21f008.png)

So I decided to remake the entire PCB for Starbie from the beginning with the goal of making it as small as possible. Which I managed to get after tedious amounts of edge cutting and wiring that can be considered a Sin at this point. The result was:

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 000652](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/6ecc1c335947d1dbae115ade928167c8d28d51e69a7c45cdb8f4f58cfebfd955.png)
With an equally majestic 3D model

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 000705](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/cfef74319483d16caae8b74fd67edf5e73c6fab5c44a3c81808e3ffdd8053ed1.png)
Overall, Now the Starbie i perfectly sized. Proportionally and wiring wise, it is considered a war crime.

TLDR; Remade whole starbie so that it is smaller and easier to fabricate
